Package io.github.projectunified.craftcommand.processor.generator

Class TypeSupport

java.lang.Object
io.github.projectunified.craftcommand.processor.generator.TypeSupport
public final class TypeSupport extends Object
Single source of truth for built-in and platform parameter types.

Each registered type carries all its compile-time behaviors (literal rendering, parsing codegen, Brigadier argument/retrieval expressions, suggestion codegen) so a beginner reads one table instead of hunting through several scattered methods.

The base instance (builtins()) covers String, the eight primitives, and their wrappers. Platform processors call register(Entry) for platform types (e.g. org.bukkit.entity.Player).
